faq_1_q: How do I get to the chalet?
faq_1_a: The chalet is located at the top of the village of Saint-Sorlin d'Arves (1600 m). Access via the A43 motorway, exit Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne, then D926. Private garage for 1 car, free parking nearby.
faq_2_q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq_2_a: Check-in from 5 pm, check-out before 10 am. Secure key box for self check-in.
faq_3_a: Duvets are provided (1 per bed). Sheets and towels are not provided. Rental available as an option.
faq_4_q: Is there a ski pass available nearby?
faq_4_a: Les Sybelles ski area (310 km of runs, 4th largest in France) is 200 m from the chalet. Free shuttle at 30 m. Ski passes available at the resort ticket offices.
faq_5_a: Yes, pets are accepted in the chalet on request.
faq_6_a: Hiking, climbing, horse riding, via ferrata, paragliding. Supervised lake at 200 m. Garden with barbecue.
